item.text: {"decisions":[{"item_id":"feed:2e0f0e66d0123645439edc17","version_id":"7851500fad1a1fd32a47738d59237b256015c0d5ac0598c3b0f88ac631919844","decision":"reject","reason":"The September 21 publication is within the September 11–October 10 freshness window, but this vendor-produced customer case study does not identify a substantive AI capability or test. Vita Coco's attributed comments support its experience with brand tracking; they do not establish the asserted turnaround reductions or commercial growth. No sample, timing baseline, costs, or outcome measurements are supplied. Quantilope has a direct sales incentive, and transfer from an established US beverage brand to a small business is unsubstantiated. The quoted Quirk’s presentation is underlying material to flag if encountered separately, not independent corroboration.","piece_ids":[]},{"item_id":"feed:2e19ca9487c9451754b6e5fd","version_id":"08a9d9310567015ee3fe5c8246142a41488c80eafd0b21087d233816cec6513d","decision":"reject","reason":"The October 9 item is timely but promotes the publisher's own San Francisco conference tickets rather than documenting an AI research capability, method, or practical constraint. TechCrunch can report its ticket offers, but its direct commercial incentive and unsupported 'highest-ROI' language provide no evidence of research effectiveness or value for small businesses. No relevant evaluation is supplied.","piece_ids":[]},{"item_id":"feed:322af46ae21ad26443092c84","version_id":"9f30df8aae6955ccd9ebb00d720767e9ff808618a7cd4b3318a5ccefcb4bbe71","decision":"accept","reason":"The supplied original-publication metadata dates this substantive guidance to October 2; no evidence establishes republication. Its AI section directly addresses customer-interview synthesis: 'asking AI to organize evidence you already have is very different from asking it to generate evidence you don’t have.' The requirement that every note trace to a research artifact supplies a practical validation rule. Accept as methodological guidance, not an empirical demonstration of accuracy, bias reduction, or time savings: no comparative evaluation or small-business sample is provided. Applicability outside English-language research and customer-data handling remain unaddressed. No cross-post is evident among these candidates.","piece_ids":["02","03"]},{"item_id":"feed:32944883b9dff85a7148008d","version_id":"b192c0ca1da12bd242489506681f276f83473000ed4152d9795eac13ccc33ed1","decision":"accept","reason":"The October 1 vendor announcement describes a relevant competitor-research capability: API access to insight metadata and, on request, 'the full text and source link.' Accept this as Crayon's reported capability and a traceability feature to test in a pilot. Crayon has a direct sales incentive; anonymous beta examples and 'Getting started takes minutes' do not establish effectiveness or low implementation effort. Pricing, access conditions, accuracy tests, small-business deployments, geographic coverage, unsuccessful deployments, and handling of customer call or win/loss data are missing. Source links enable checking but do not establish correctness. No duplicate appears in this batch; future coverage repeating these beta examples would repeat underlying claims, not independently corroborate them.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}]}
